correct_completion: we took a taxi to the airport.
full_sentence: Because the train was late, we took a taxi to the airport.
acceptable_variants: we booked a hotel near the station.
we decided to wait on the platform.

options.text: we had a lot of free time.
options.why_wrong: A late train creates a problem to solve, so it does not lead to free time as a result.
This contradicts the stated cause: the train was late, so it cannot be described as very fast here.

options.text: we took a taxi to the airport.
we were happy to see it.
options.why_wrong: This describes a feeling about the train, not a result of the delay, so it does not complete the cause-and-effect link.

explanation: After 'because', the first clause gives the cause, and the main clause must give a logical result of that cause. Here the delay is the cause, so the result must be an action that solves the problem.
translation: Porque o trem estava atrasado, pegamos um táxi até o aeroporto.
